series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_style_standard: Adult cinematic physically realistic 3D historical reconstruction & live-action 65mm location cinematography (ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo primes, Kodak Vision3 500T grade: warm sandstone highlights, deep cerulean Summer Sea, lush emerald pastures, muted volcanic stone)
visual_qc_note: All ten frames were visually reviewed and approved as a progression from ore-bearing basalt and obsidian to the first anatomically canonical subterranean firewyrm reveal. The two earlier weak renders were replaced: IMG0201 now shows a subdued non-luminous copper seam; IMG0205 is clearly an enclosed subterranean fissure without a surface skyline. All ten are 1376x768 sRGB PNGs; Drive lists exactly ten images and every Drive MD5 matches the local file.
